name: Garrett Pro-Pointer AT
summary: A handheld metal pinpointer for narrowing a permitted search after a target is located. The 1140900 model uses a single 9 V battery, audio/vibration feedback and a documented 6 m waterproof rating.
description: The Pro-Pointer AT suits detectorists who need to narrow the position of metal in a small area or excavated material. It is a close-search pinpointer, rather than a replacement for a full-size search detector. Use the tip and side-scan area to work methodically, retuning around mineralised ground or a larger target as the instructions describe. A tone or vibration means a metal response; it does not identify the object, establish that it is safe to touch or determine whether it belongs to you. Compare a full-size detector when the task is surveying a broader area, and keep retrieval tools and legal access separate from the detector purchase. This FALLOUT exploration category is editorial organisation: the Pro-Pointer AT is a metal detector, not a radiation detector, hazardous-material detector or fictional anomaly detector. The approved orange artwork remains unchanged.

pros: A separate pinpointer lets a user narrow a metal response without moving a full-size search coil over the same small spot.
Audio and vibration provide two forms of feedback during a close search.
Single-battery operation gives the kit a clear spare-power requirement.
cons: A pinpointer’s close-search role is limited; detection depth depends on target size, orientation, soil and sensitivity. No universal depth is promised.
It cannot identify hazardous objects, radiation, chemical contamination or whether an excavation is safe.
The standard 1140900 does not establish Z-Lynk wireless functionality. Current Canadian package contents and warranty need confirmation.
useCases: Recreational detectorists pinpointing metal on land where searching and excavation are permitted.
Close inspection of excavated loose material after a broader search, subject to site safety and permission.
Users who need a separate spare 9 V battery plan; the related AA and AAA battery kits are not substitutes.

safetyNotes: Obtain landowner permission and check applicable local restrictions before searching or digging. Avoid protected heritage sites and buried services.
Do not touch, move or dig around ammunition, suspected explosives, sharps or unidentified hazardous objects. Withdraw and notify the appropriate authority. A pinpointer does not make an object safe.
Close the battery compartment and follow the delivered waterproofing instructions before wet use. A depth rating is not a guarantee for damaged seals or careless maintenance.
This is metal detection only. Radiation and hazardous-material assessment require different equipment and qualified procedures.
